label: sec:step-archimedean
html:
Archimedean step. Specialisation at the observed substrate parameter q_0 produces archimedean (real-valued, dimensional) quantities and yields a dimensional mass. The machinery is a chain of extensions of the generic categorical content. Stated over a commutative ring R, it specialises through R \to R[i] \to R[i][q, q^{-1}]. The parameter q is uniquely extracted as a categorical invariant (§\ref{thm:substrate-parameter-unique}); its value q_0 at our location and energy scale is observed, not derived from Bring topology.

The mass endomorphism \mathfrak{m}(K) = \mathrm{Vol}(K) \cdot c_q^{-2} is the non-abelian Stokes integration of the Reeb flow against the categorical action. We evaluate it using Wedderburn decomposition, partition channels y_\lambda \chi^\lambda, crystal bases, and \Delta_\lambda gating.

Alternatives to the archimedean specialisation include p-adic (R \to \mathbb{Q}_p) and characteristic-p (R \to \mathbb{F}_p[T]) substrate completions. These are non-archimedean and do not produce dimensional masses.
